history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-21, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#578; borg-reborn-rs #829, PR #833). Pilot (RULES 16)
on classes-18, then classes-1800-small and classes-1800-medium (a development set: the three named dossiers, Priest
354395849, Ranger 1088421828 and Warrior 1653223723, come from the medium tier; no sealed suite; a confirmation on a fresh
block is the owner's to open), 100,000 turns, one binary, two arms paired on the same starts. The arms play identically
until the first teleport after a curse is learned: report how many pairs are identical.
Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's value in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or
borg_stopped; stalls, timeouts and crashes kept apart, counted, never dropped; frozen-turn bursts classified.
Primary: among games where ctl read "Teleportation forbidden!" at least once, the number of "Teleportation forbidden!" in
block while the block holds must be 0 (notes "# Teleport blocked (anti-teleportation on ...)" and "# Teleport block
lifted"); any further "forbidden" in block is a defect to report (a no-teleport grid explains some: say which).
Secondary: all games, deaths and causes per arm, CL at death, deepest level, identical plays; the list of curse games
(seed, class, item named in the note, game turn of the block, outcome in each arm); a RULES 18 bin; death reports for
every death among the curse games.
experiment.question: On borg-reborn-rs 6fe184ea (PR #833), among games where the control read "Teleportation forbidden!" at least once, does refusing every teleport of the player while an anti-teleportation curse holds (escape_teleport_block 1) stop the Phase Door reads under the curse, and does it change deaths, progress or add stalls?
